transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I'd like to get our preflight meeting underway so we can finalize the showcase package for the Harborlight Theater. As a reminder, the showcase is set for one evening at the Harborlight, immediately after the feature-film premiere. The current production draft calls for an eight-piece live band, a 90-minute performance, 'Neon Atlas' as the closing song, and permission for audience members to make personal recordings. Before I can sign off on the final showcase package, I need the technical director and the music rights coordinator to report their final checks. Could we start with those reports?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. I received the completed power survey from the Harborlight electrician this morning. The theater can safely support a live band only if it is configured as six musicians, not eight. Additionally, the electrical load plan permits a maximum performance length of 75 minutes, not the 90 minutes called for in the current draft. I haven't entered these results in the production draft yet because the signed survey arrived after the draft was circulated.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a critical issue on the music rights side. I confirmed with the publisher that 'Neon Atlas' is not cleared for this live showcase. The publisher has approved 'Glass River' as the replacement closing song, but the license prohibits audience recording of the performance. I'm also still waiting for the countersigned license scan before I can attach it to the show file.
transcript.speaker: A3
